title: Clinical Insights: A Comprehensive Review of Language Models in Medicine.

bias_targets.methodology: The paper acts as a comprehensive review and does not conduct original empirical measurements; rather, it evaluates racial bias by reviewing existing literature (e.g., Levine et al.) that tested GPT-3's diagnostic and triage accuracy to identify the perpetuation of racial biases in medical contexts.

The paper conducts a literature review, citing external empirical studies (e.g., Levine et al.) that evaluated the diagnostic and triage accuracy of language models like GPT-3 and documented the models' exhibition of gender bias.
